Who we are looking for

We are looking for a Data and AI Program Manager reporting directly to global Data and AI Chief of Staff. You will serve as an enterprise leader for Data and AI, overseeing the planning, execution, and delivery of enterprise wide Data and AI initiatives.

Why this role is important to us

The team you will be joining is a part of Data and AI organization, a function that is vital to the company. The Data and AI Program Manager will ensure the disciplined execution and value realization while delivering clear, compelling communication to internal and external stakeholders. The role operates at the intersection of strategy, program management, and executive communication.

What you will be responsible for

As a Data and AI Program Manager, you will:
·       Coordinate and lead global Data and AI Programs by partnering with cross‑regional technology teams, business stakeholders, and vendors on the planning, execution, and implementation of IT initiatives . Own day‑to‑day management of assigned programs to ensure delivery against agreed scope, schedule, budget, and quality.
·        Own program documentation and governance , including program plans, status reports, and key decision records. Ensure full alignment with program and project governance, risk management, and audit requirements , and provide proactive support during internal or external reviews.
·        Identify, track, and manage program and operational risks , maintaining up‑to‑date mitigation and contingency plans. Proactively resolve issues where possible and escalate critical risks and dependencies in a timely and structured manner to ensure informed decision‑making by leadership.
·        Act as a key stakeholder interface , ensuring alignment across technology, business, and management teams, and delivering clear, accurate, and audience‑appropriate program communications.

What we value
These skills will help you succeed in this role
·        Experience in Enterprise wide program management with demonstrated project management capability in technology‑enabled environments.
·        Excellent communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with global, cross‑functional stakeholders in both verbal and written contexts.
·        High proficiency in project and productivity tools , including Microsoft Office, MS Project, Jira, Clarity, Confluence, and similar platforms. Experience with analytics tools such as Power BI is a plus.
·        Experience in IT Compliance,  Data Management, or AI project management is a plus.
·        Ability to manage multiple priorities under pressure, demonstrating resilience, adaptability, and sound judgment in fast‑paced and high‑pressure situations.

Education & Preferred Qualifications
·        Bachelor’s degree in Management, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related discipline.
·        Minimum of 5 years of relevant experience in program management, vendor management, capacity planning, or PMO related roles.  Experience working on large-scale programs is preferred.
·        Strong knowledge of SDLC, Agile and Waterfall methodologies.
·        Demonstrated technical understanding of software engineering concepts (e.g., system architecture, APIs/integrations, data flows, cloud basics).
·        PMP certification, Data Governance, or any additional project management–related certifications are highly desirable.

jobs.description:
Who we are looking for
We are looking for a Business Risk Management Alternatives – Managing Director, Business Risk Management Alternatives, who will be part of the Global Delivery Business Risk Management Leadership Team and the Alternatives Functional Leadership Team.

Why this role is important to us
Alternative Investment Solutions is a recognized industry-leading provider of fund accounting, fund administration and risk services to private equity, hedge funds and private credit funds. These services are fully integrated to provide complete end-to-end solutions that span the front-, middle- and back-office requirements and is a focused growth area for State Street.

What you will be responsible for
Critical business priorities:
- Acting as a valued partner to the Alternatives Business in the identification, assessment, and mitigation of risk collaborating with the wider global GD BRM organization and GD Business

- Ensuring that the BRM framework. principles and methodologies for identifying, analyzing, monitoring and minimizing business risks are consistent and adopted by the Alternative leadership team with alignment to regional requirements based on the locations Alternatives operates from.

- Understanding and engagement in the overall strategy of the business

- Requires in-depth domain knowledge in risk/compliance, process and control reviews, change risk management, problem-solving skills, and deep knowledge of the financial industry and State Street products and services

jobs.title: Head of Marketing - State Street Investment Management, Senior Managing Director
jobs.description:
Overview
As the Head of Marketing at State Street Investment Management you will lead a global marketing organization, reporting to the firm’s Global Chief Marketing Officer. You will be responsible for setting and executing the marketing strategy for the global investment management business, the 4th largest asset manager in the world, across institutional, intermediary, and retail audiences, with a focus on strengthening brand resonance, and driving integrated marketing programs that support AUM growth and deepening client and partner relationships.

In this leadership role you will be responsible for translating business priorities into coordinated marketing strategies that reinforce State Street Investment Management’s position as a leading global asset manager and ensure alignment across investment, distribution, and corporate partners. You will be accountable for all aspects of marketing strategy and execution across the Investment Management business. While directly leading the commercial and regional marketing teams, you will partner closely with marketing centers of excellence to deliver best in class marketing programming.

This role will be a member of the Investment Management Executive Management Group and the Global Marketing Leadership Team.

Executive Leadership Impact
The Head of Marketing at State Street Investment Management serves as a senior advisor to global Investments leadership partnering closely with Investment, Distribution, Product, and Corporate leadership teams to align marketing strategy with commercial priorities and client needs.

You will be responsible for shaping how marketing contributes to client acquisition, retention, brand differentiation, and long-term asset growth, while strengthening the firm’s positioning across global markets and client segments. The Head of Marketing at State Street Investment Management plays a key role in engaging with fund boards, building trust and alignment around marketing strategy, use of fund assets, fiduciary obligations and regulatory expectations.

The role partners with the Global CMO and the marketing leadership team in advancing the marketing operating model and capabilities required to support a modern, data-driven, and digitally enabled global investment business, while ensuring strong governance, regulatory compliance, and fiduciary oversight.

What you will be responsible for:
- Collaborate with Business leaders globally to define a marketing strategy that aligns with business priorities and commercial objectives.

- Partner with Investments, Distribution, Product, Research, Portfolio Management, Regional Leadership and Corporate leadership to translate business priorities into integrated marketing strategies.

- Develop tighter commercial alignment, with marketing plans and integrated marketing programs that directly contribute to client acquisition, retention, cross-sell, product adoption, and expansion across institutional, intermediary, and retail segments globally.

- Oversee development of differentiated content and thought leadership that strengthens investment credibility and establishes market-leading positioning.

- Lead brand, advertising and sponsorship strategy aligned with Investment Management’s growth ambition, strengthening equity and recall in strategic global markets, engaging key audience segments, reinforcing differentiation, and drives choice and action.

- Establish and lead a robust product marketing capability to support and activate new product launches.

- Champion a data-driven approach to decision-making, leveraging analytics, market intelligence, client insights, and marketing technology to improve marketing effectiveness and inform strategic priorities.

- Drive the development of modern marketing capabilities, including digital, data, analytics, and MarTech strategies, to enhance client engagement and marketing effectiveness.

- Establish clear marketing attribution, measurement, and ROI frameworks that demonstrate business impact and support investment decisions.

- Manage and optimize a global marketing budget, ensuring disciplined investment decisions, resource productivity, vendor effectiveness and measurable business impact.

- Shape and evolve the marketing operating model, including governance, prioritization, resource allocation, vendor management, budget oversight, and global coordination.

- Partner with fund boards, governance forums, and control functions to ensure marketing activities support fiduciary obligations, regulatory requirements and strategic business objectives.

- Ensure all marketing activities meet applicable regulatory, fiduciary, legal, risk, and compliance standards within a global asset management environment.

- Contribute as a senior leader within to enterprise strategy, transformation initiatives, talent development, and organizational effectiveness.

Education & Preferred Qualifications:
- 20+ years marketing leadership experience within asset management, financial services, wealth management, or other highly regulated financial services environments.

- Proven ability to lead global marketing strategy and execution across brand, content, digital, communications, analytics, and client engagement functions.

- Experience leading large global marketing organizations, including regional and country marketing teams, shared services models, and direct and matrixed leadership structures, with demonstrated ability to operate across diverse markets and cultural contexts.

- Ability to inspire high-performing teams through a clear strategic vision, fostering alignment, accountability and results.

- Deep understanding of investment products, client segments, distribution channels, capital markets, and marketing’s role in driving commercial outcomes.

- Ability to build trusted partnerships and collaborate effectively across a diverse constituency of clients, business partners, vendors, and cross-functional stakeholders.

- Experience leveraging data, analytics, client insights, and marketing technology to shape strategy and improve effectiveness.

- Proven track record of leading organizational transformation, operating model design, and large-scale change initiatives.

- Deep expertise in marketing strategy, campaign development, execution, and the application of data and analytics to improve effectiveness and demonstrate ROI.

- Strong governance, risk, and compliance mindset within highly regulated environments.

Are you the right candidate?
Yes! We truly believe in the power that comes from the diverse backgrounds and experiences our employees bring with them. Although each vacancy details what we are looking for, we don’t necessarily need you to fulfil all of them when applying. If you like change and innovation, seek to see the bigger picture, make data driven decisions and are a good team player, you could be a great fit.

jobs.title: Enterprise Risk Management, Vice President
jobs.description:
Who we are looking for
We are looking for an Enterprise Risk Management, Vice President to provide leadership in executing Audit’s assurance coverage over Non-Financial risks.  Enterprise Risk Management provides independent risk oversight over State Street’s business activities. The Non-Financial Risks include Technology, Cyber Security, Data Management, Transaction Processing, Product, Resiliency, Non-Technology Change Management, Third-Party, Fraud, Reporting, Human Capital, Legal and Strategic risks. In this role, you will report directly to the Corporate Audit Managing Director for Enterprise Risk Management, and you will support the annual audit planning and development, risk assessment, scoping and execution of audits related to the associated processes and risks. You will also play a critical role in the ongoing development of audit staff and support various departmental initiatives.
This role is based out of Boston, Massachusetts. Due to the onsite role requirements this job needs to be performed primarily in the office with some flex work opportunities available.

Why this role is important to us
The team you will be joining plays an important role in the overall success of the organization. Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability; regulators rely upon us to provide assurance that the bank operates in a manner that is compliant with key banking regulations to properly manage risks to the company and the global financial systems. To make that happen we need teams like yours to help navigate employees and the organization as a whole. In your role, you will help us build resilience and execute day-to-day deliverables at our best. Join us if making your mark in the financial services industry from day one is a challenge you are up for.

What you will be responsible for
As a Non-Financial Risk Management, Vice President you will:
- Build a risk-based strategy for coverage of Non-Financial Risk
- Provide insights on the evolving regulatory environment and interact with regulators.
- Stay abreast of industry matters and efficiently and effectively apply applicable new developments in audit projects.
- Prepare and deliver periodic management reports to key stakeholders including executive management, governance committees, and regulatory bodies.
- Participate as a non-voting member of business / risk committees and management working groups, promoting balanced discussions, and encouraging challenge and debate.
- Participate in the development of a risk-based global non-financial risk audit plan through the execution of detailed risk assessments, which consider existing and emerging risks, key strategic initiatives, regulatory requirements / expectations and effectiveness of the control environment.
- Support the execution of the risk-based global non-financial risk audit plan through the review and approval of audit work products; ensuring effective coverage and the timely escalation of issues and conclusions.
- Draft, review, finalize and communicate audit deliverables, including audit findings, memos and audit reports to senior and executive management.
- Ensure audit engagements properly align to all internal standards and performance metrics.
- Maintain effective partnerships with key senior leaders in the Non-Financial Risk organization by identifying potential control risks and gaps while development and implementation activities are underway.
- Influence effective and sustainable improvements to processes and controls.
- Manage, coach and develop staff, including participating in talent management, staff evaluation, and new hire processes.

What we value
These skills will help you succeed in this role:
- Strong knowledge and understanding of Non-Financial Risks, including Technology, Cyber Security, Data Management, Transaction Processing, Product, Resiliency, Non-Technology Change Management, Third-Party, Model, Fraud, Reporting, Human Capital, Legal and Strategic risks.
- Experience with enterprise risk programs (e.g., material risk identification, RCSA, BCBS 239, Technology, Cyber, Resiliency, and Artificial Intelligence Risk Frameworks).
- Strategic thinking that focuses on developing innovative solutions to optimize execution approaches while maintaining efficiency.
- Ability to manage complex global audit programs across multiple risk disciplines and programs and develop strong relationships in both first and second line of defense to allow for effective review and challenge.
- Strong communication, interpersonal and leadership abilities across all levels coupled with effective problem solving, conceptual thinking, quantitative and analytical skills.
- Ability to manage complexity, effectively prioritize multiple tasks and work independently in non-routine situations and in a fast-paced environment.
- Strong leadership skills that create an inclusive environment for building, cultivating and managing diverse teams.
- Highly collaborative with an ability to develop and maintain strong relationships within the department and with stakeholders across the lines of defense.
- Fluency in English – Written and spoken

Qualifications
- 12-15 years of experience in Internal Audit, Risk Management, or related functions within financial services, including custody bank.
- Bachelor’s degree, preferable in finance, accounting or related field.
- Advanced degree or certification (CPA, CRISC, CISA, CDPSE, CDPM, AAIA, AAIR, CGEIT) preferred.
- Deep expertise in executing or auditing non-financial risk programs, including RCSA, BCBS 239, Technology, Cyber, Resiliency, and Artificial Intelligence Risk Frameworks)
- Extensive experience leading global audit engagements and interacting with regulators.
- Strong understanding of global regulatory expectations and industry standards impacting non-financial risks.

jobs.title: Global Treasury Operations, Manager
jobs.description:
Who we are looking for
An experienced individual for our Markets Operations who demonstrates subject matter expertise in one or more responsibilities of the operation that includes the execution of Global Treasury investment portfolio and/or liability management related workflows, supports Funding and Collateral Transformation products in line with market deadlines and internal SLAs. The individual works independently with regard to accomplishing responsibilities, strives to provide excellent client service and supports Risk Excellence culture of State Street. The individual should possess extensive knowledge and experience on securities, settlements, rates, treasury products, and related financial attributes. Will require to work closely with Business teams, Functional teams, Business Risk, Compliance and Technology teams on day-to-day basis to ensure seamless BAU. A large element of the role is transformation of the function, from operating model changes to a new technology infrastructure to reduce risk, create efficiency and improve service delivery. The role will be needed to drive the transformation whilst remaining focused on BAU so as to not compromise on service.

Why this role is important to us

The team you will be joining plays an important role in the overall success of State Street. As a leading provider of trading and lending solutions to the world’s institutional investors, we deliver the industry’s most innovative platforms, financing and portfolio solutions. Our capabilities are backed by proprietary, high-value research, insights and indicators that power clients’ investment decisions, accelerate performance and help investors stay ahead of shifting markets. Across our comprehensive set of solutions – data-driven macro market intelligence that give an information advantage; client-first platforms and tools that redefine trading; financing solutions that streamline liquidity access; and portfolio solutions designed to help achieve peak performance – we deliver a breakthrough edge to drive business success.

What you will be responsible for

As an Officer you will
- Liaise with front office, compliance, finance, claims, and IT teams to support the full trade lifecycle.

- Responsible for Markets participation in programs such as ISO 20022, TD+1, and other bank wide initiatives.

- Provide Trade Support for Asset Management and Liability Management teams of Global Treasury

- Actively participate in the Peer Repo project and implementation

- Monitor exception reporting and provide necessary insight on resolution

- Monitor derivative and investment portfolio valuations and report on exceptions

- Investigate recon variances and provide root cause analysis

- Provide trade support and static data set up for Funding and Collateral Transformation team

- Monitor and perform collateral management functions in accordance with approved policies and procedures

- Oversee daily activities and help junior team members with subject matter expertise, trainings and understanding the core business operations

- Proposes and works to implement workflow changes, leading to improved productivity

- Work directly with the business and other Global Treasury stakeholders to provide information and/or operational solutions as needed

- Work proactively on updating job aids and procedures, making sure that team is adhering to the newly adopted processes

- Support the “Risk Excellence” culture within the business

- Work well with all GTO members and GT/GM stakeholders as demonstrated by being responsive to requests, striving for excellent client service

- Execute Funds & Securities Transfers for Repo/Reverse Repo activities.

- Perform or approve cash/GL processing.

- Take a leadership role in broader based projects as a subject matter expert.

- Responsible for KRI/Operating Metrics reporting and other overarching team related responsibilities.

- Focus on the control environment to drive a strong risk & control culture across the global teams to ensure processes are robust & compliant.

- Partner with Technology and partake in Markets Operations to deliver a best-in-class E2E workflow solution, removing manual touchpoints and increasing STP

- Support applicable Change the Bank and Run the Bank Projects impacting the team, from inception; providing SME support, testing and monitoring into Production.

- Ensure vendor oversight and hold them accountable to high standards of delivery. Stay abreast of all regulatory and market changes and ensure adherence and no impact to service standards as a result of these changes.

- Partner with ERM and compliance colleagues globally to ensure Markets Operations remains disciplined with respect to adherence to resiliency strategy, control assurance etc.

jobs.title: Quantitative Analyst, Officer, Hybrid
jobs.description:
Who we are looking for
State Street Markets (“SSM”) is looking for an Officer to join the SSM Model Risk team in Boston. The SSM Model Risk team provides solutions to SSM business units, including Financing Solutions, FX Sales & Trading, Portfolio Solutions, GlobalLink, State Street Associates and Market Surveillance, allowing business units to address Model Risk requirements from internal oversight functions and external regulators.

Work arrangement
This role can be performed in a hybrid model, where you can balance work from home and office to match your needs and role requirements.

Why this role is important to us
The team you will be joining is a part of State Street Markets. As a leading provider of trading and lending solutions to the world’s institutional investors, we deliver the industry’s most innovative platforms, financing and portfolio solutions. Our capabilities are backed by proprietary, high-value research, insights and indicators that power clients’ investment decisions, accelerate performance and help investors stay ahead of shifting markets.
Join us if making your mark in the capital markets industry from day one is a challenge you are up for.

What you will be responsible for
As Markets Quantitative Analyst, Officer, you will:
- Support model owners in the execution of engagement-specific statistical and financial modeling and analyses, and in the preparation of final model deliverables.

- Support the Markets Risk and Capital Optimization team on capital- and liquidity-related quantitative analyses.

- Develop customized solutions to perform independent model testing and document the development methodology and implementation process.

- Establish appropriate benchmarking and back-testing techniques based on the model class, purpose, horizon, hedging implications, and other relevant factors.

- Identify key model risks by stress-testing model inputs and parameters.

- Demonstrate model stability across alternative specifications and input ranges, including extreme values and boundaries of model effectiveness.

- Collaborate with model owners to design and implement ongoing monitoring plans, including performance metrics, thresholds and escalation plans.

- Develop first-line-of-defense documentation covering model development, implementation and ongoing monitoring.

- Work with model owners and developers to update models in line with internal model validation requirements.

- Conduct post-implementation reviews of SSM proprietary trading algorithms, including code and strategy changes, compliance with the FX Global Code, and independent testing of selected components.

- Communicate with quantitative professionals and developers to understand strategy changes and justify modeling assumptions and results to internal model validation and external regulators.

- Prepare and deliver engagement status updates to key stakeholders and manage workflows to ensure timely deliverables.

What we value
These skills will help you succeed in this role:
- Strong understanding of quantitative analysis methods in relation to financial institutions.

- Knowledge of financial markets, including securities lending, equities and derivatives, FX or electronic trading, is a plus.

- High-level understanding of capital- and liquidity-related regulations.

- Ability to multitask and operate in a fast-paced, deadline-oriented environment.

- Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to explain complex concepts, facilitate discussions and resolve conflicts among stakeholders with competing interests.

Education & Preferred Qualifications
- Graduate degree in a quantitative discipline, such as Financial Mathematics, Financial Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics or a related field.

- 0-3 years of experience in the model risk field preferred.

- Advanced programming skills in at least one supported statistical programming environment, including Python, R or MATLAB.

- Intermediate programming skills in VBA and other languages; Java experience is a plus.

jobs.title: Data Governance Analyst, Officer
jobs.description:
SSBI Data Governance & Management team supports the Finance function to ensure compliance with BCBS 239 requirements.

This role is responsible for implementing data governance practices, data quality controls, and reporting frameworks to ensure that the Finance organization's data management practices comply with BCBS 239 standards. This role is part of SSBI RDAR framework adapting the Data Steward role from the global Data Governance policy and is responsible to apply to standards, frameworks and controls to ensure that the organization's data management practices comply with BCBS 239 standards.

Data Stewards are subject matter experts for certain data sets typically aligned with business applications. Data Stewards maintain business metadata within the Data Catalog to enable a common understanding of data context, meaning and lineage. Data Stewards also support the Business Owner to implement data management. controls related to data quality and data use.

Responsibilities:
- Maintaining and developing Data Quality Framework for Risk, Finance and Treasury
- Maintain data dictionary aligned to enterprise glossary to ensure data context and meaning is clear to Data Consumers and other stakeholders
- Manage Data Provider/Consumer relationships and confirm that data is fit for purpose
- Engage Business Owners to verify that operational controls (business and IT) are implemented and fully documented to mitigate data quality risks.
- Capture technical metadata and associate physical data structures to business data element definitions within the Data Catalog.
- Ensure that application data lineage (inputs, outputs) is accurate and updated in the Data Catalog.
- Participate in data integration projects to ensure appropriate data is used, data quality controls are implemented, and the Data Catalog is updated.
- Drive resolution of data quality issues and exceptions by collaborating with business process owners, technology experts or other key stakeholder and subject matter experts.
- Participating in the preparation and execution of comprehensive, end to end Data Quality testing
- Being an active participant of the continues improvement initiatives aiming to increase the team's productivity through appropriate analysis and re-engineering business processes
- Status reporting on assigned tasks.

Requirements and Qualifications
- Strong understanding of data management concepts, principles and practices
- Strong interpersonal and communication skills to influence staff and customers are required.
- Strong written and oral communication skills to motivate and influence staff and customers are required.
- Hands-on experience and full understanding (SME level) of data sets relevant for BU.
- Ability to understand data models, data taxonomy, and a deep appreciation of data standards and data quality.
- Microsoft Office suite (PowerPoint, Excel, Power Query, Power Pivot), Word and Visio
- Experience with SQL and BI tools (Power BI) are preferably
- Strong project management skills to manage multiple issues simultaneously.
- Self-confidence, high energy and tenacity in bringing issues to closure and moving forward are highly desired.
- Bachelor's degree in a related field (e.g., Business, Information Technology, Finance)
- 5+ years of experience in the financial industry, preferably in capital markets or financial markets infrastructure, with roles in data governance, risk management of compliance
- Ability to take ownership and initiative, be accountable and proactive, and work independently in a fast-paced environment
